description_en: Queries the earliest and latest message timestamps currently stored on the server for a specified topic, as well as the most recent consumption time of the consumer
description_zh: 可以查询某个 Topic 当前服务器上存在的消息的最新时间和最早时间，以及查询消费端最近消费的时间
name: QueryMqSofamqConsumerTimespan

parameters.help_en: The cell where the consumer group ID to query resides
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID 所在的 Cell
parameters.name: cell

parameters.help_en: The consumer group ID to query
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID that corresponds to the consumer group ID to query. This parameter is required for instances that have independent namespaces
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID 所对应的实例 ID。针对有独立命名空间的实例，该参数为必填
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The topic subscribed to by the consumer group ID to query
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID 订阅的 Topic
parameters.name: topic
